name: Public discovery, detail and legal pages work
description: Verifies visitors can discover public content, open detail routes and reach the site's legal information.
steps: Open the public site
Open Experiences and select an experience
Open Events and select a visible event
On an event detail page, download the calendar file and confirm it contains the event title, date, time and location
Use Share event and confirm the public event URL can be shared or copied
Open View map and confirm the event location is passed to the map search
Reload the page and confirm the same event detail is still shown
Press the browser back button and confirm the Events list is shown
Open Journal and select a story
Use the footer to open Privacy Policy, then Terms of Use
Return to the homepage
expected: Public content details remain navigable and reloadable, browser back returns to the previous list, and both legal pages open from the footer without authentication. Event detail also provides a downloadable calendar entry, a shareable detail URL and a map-search link.

name: Super Admin can operate core CMS content
covers: dashboard recent event and enquiry empty states
description: Verifies the authorised administrator can use the core CMS modules and persist meaningful content changes.
steps: Open the private admin entry point
Sign in with the authorised Super Admin account
Review the overview metrics and recent events/enquiries panels
Use the dashboard quick action to open event creation
Create and publish an event
Edit the event and archive it
Create and publish a journal story
Create and publish an announcement
Open Messages and update a message status
Open site content settings and save a homepage change
Refresh the dashboard
expected: The authorised administrator reaches the CMS, content operations persist, and dashboard counts reflect the updated state.

name: Contact, WhatsApp and media workflows work
description: Verifies visitors can submit an enquiry, reach the team directly and the administrator can maintain uploaded media.
steps: Open Contact
Confirm WhatsApp, email and phone contact links are visible
Open the WhatsApp link and confirm it targets the official business number
Submit a valid enquiry
Open the private admin CMS
Open Messages and find the new enquiry
Open Media and upload an image
Confirm the image appears
Remove the uploaded image
expected: The WhatsApp shortcut targets +2348140098691, direct email and phone links use the official contact details, the enquiry is saved and visible to the administrator, and uploaded media can be maintained.

name: Google Photos is protected and retryable
description: Verifies Google Photos is available only inside the authorised CMS and can be retried after cancellation.
steps: Open the private admin route
Authenticate as the Super Admin
Open Media
Open the Google Photos Media Hub
Start the Google Photos connection or picker flow
If authorization is cancelled, retry from Media
expected: Google Photos controls are protected by admin authorization and cancellation leaves a usable retry state.

name: PWA install, offline awareness, and accessibility
description: Verifies the progressive web app supports an install flow where the browser permits it and communicates connection state without disrupting navigation.
steps: Open the site in a supported mobile browser
Confirm the browser offers installation when eligible
Go offline and observe the offline status message
Restore the connection
Navigate between public pages using keyboard or touch
expected: The app shell remains available from cache where possible, a branded offline fallback is shown when the shell is unavailable, connection state is communicated, and the layout remains usable on mobile.

name: Multi-ticket event booking and manual transfer review
description: Verifies one purchaser can book multiple attendee tickets in one checkout, capacity is reserved for the complete quantity, and paid tickets remain inactive until an administrator verifies actual bank credit.
steps: Publish a test event with a known NGN ticket price and a finite capacity in a non-production test environment.
Configure test-only manual transfer bank details in the test environment secrets.
Open the event detail page and select three tickets.
Enter purchaser contact details and three distinct attendee names, then submit once.
Confirm the booking shows one payment reference, three tickets and the correct total.
Submit a transfer reference and confirm the booking remains pending and no tickets are issued.
Open the admin Bookings & tickets panel and verify the pending booking is visible.
Confirm the administrator cannot proceed without confirming actual bank credit and entering an audit note.
In the test environment, verify the transfer and confirm all three tickets are issued exactly once.
Open the confirmed booking and generate the QR code for each attendee ticket
Download a ticket QR image and scan it with a phone camera to confirm it contains the ULC-TICKET credential
Paste the scanned ULC-TICKET payload into the admin check-in field and confirm the ticket is accepted
Attempt to check in the same ticket twice and confirm the second attempt is rejected.
Retry the original booking request with the same idempotency key and confirm no second booking is created.
Create another unpaid test booking and confirm its hold is released after expiry.
expected: A single booking contains three attendee tickets, consumes three capacity units atomically, and cannot be duplicated by retries. Manual-transfer submissions do not issue tickets. Administrator confirmation after independent bank-credit verification issues one unique ticket per attendee, check-in is one-time, and expired unpaid holds release their reserved capacity. These are manual QA steps and require a sandbox/test environment; they are not represented as already executed. Each attendee can generate and download a local QR code; an administrator can paste the scanned ticket payload into check-in.
